_notes.source: Cross-verified against the independent spice deck card list during the leaders.json/treacheryDeck.json pass. Territory card values are NOT duplicated in this file, deliberately, spiceEngine.js looks them up from territories.json's spiceBlow.maxValue at draw time so the two files can't silently drift apart.
_notes.composition: 6 Shai-Hulud (worm) cards, plus one territory card per spice-blow territory in territories.json (15 in the base game). Matches the rulebook's description of the deck exactly.
